保誠 Prudential 2011 電視廣告「We Believe in Listening」

集團亞洲區總部於2011年1月5日推出新一輪品牌宣傳活動，涵蓋電視、平面、戶外及網絡廣告。 是次廣告宣傳建基於公司 「用心聆聽，更知你心」的企業理念，以帶出聆聽之重要性，保誠深信只要用心聆聽，便能領略和體會一切。 A new brand campaign encompassing television, print, outdoor and online advertisements will be launched from 5 January 2011. Beginning in Hong Kong, the campaign will roll-out across Asia over the coming year. Builds upon the company's "Always Listening Always Understanding" credo, the campaign focuses on the importance of listening and all that can be learned and understood when you listen.
